definition: The system does not allow you to read, change or run a file.
exampleSentence: I got a permission denied error because the file belongs to another user.

definition: The other computer did not answer in time.
exampleSentence: The deployment failed with connection timed out after thirty seconds.

definition: Still working but old, and will be removed in a future version.
exampleSentence: The compiler warns that this function is deprecated and will be removed soon.

definition: An error when code tries to use an object that does not exist.
exampleSentence: The app crashed with a null pointer exception when the user list was empty.

definition: The system cannot find the file at the given path.
exampleSentence: Check the path, because the script stopped with file not found.

definition: The program needs more memory than the computer can give.
exampleSentence: The image processing job crashed with an out of memory error.

definition: A mistake in the way code is written.
exampleSentence: A missing bracket caused a syntax error on line twelve.

definition: You do not have permission to open a resource.
exampleSentence: The website showed access denied because my account had no admin rights.

definition: The other computer rejected the connection, often because the service is not running.
exampleSentence: We got connection refused because the database server was not running.

definition: The request needs a valid login or token.
exampleSentence: The API returned unauthorized because my token had expired.

definition: You are logged in but not allowed to access this resource.
exampleSentence: The server answered forbidden even though my password was correct.

definition: Something went wrong on the server while handling the request.
exampleSentence: The checkout page showed an internal server error after the update.

definition: The server could not understand the request because it was wrong.
exampleSentence: The API returned bad request because a required field was missing.

definition: The server is overloaded or down for maintenance.
exampleSentence: Users saw service unavailable during the planned maintenance window.

definition: A list of the function calls that led to an error.
exampleSentence: Paste the full stack trace into the ticket so we can find the bug.

definition: An error that happens while a program is running.
exampleSentence: The code catches the exception and shows a friendly message to the user.

definition: A crash when a program tries to use memory it is not allowed to use.
exampleSentence: The old C program stopped with a segmentation fault on the new server.

definition: When Git cannot combine two changes to the same lines automatically.
exampleSentence: I had to fix a merge conflict before my pull request could be merged.

definition: The code could not be compiled or packaged.
exampleSentence: The pipeline shows build failed because one test is broken.

definition: The terminal does not know the command you typed.
exampleSentence: The terminal printed command not found because the tool was not installed.

definition: The disk is full, so no more data can be written.
exampleSentence: The logs filled the disk, and the server reported no space left on device.

definition: The username or password is wrong.
exampleSentence: The login page said invalid credentials, so I reset my password.

definition: You were logged out because you were inactive for too long.
exampleSentence: After lunch, the website said session expired and asked me to log in.

definition: A security certificate is no longer valid, so the connection is not trusted.
exampleSentence: The website was blocked because its certificate expired on Sunday.

definition: You sent requests too quickly and must wait.
exampleSentence: The API returned too many requests, so our script waited one minute.

definition: The code tries to load a library that is not installed.
exampleSentence: Run the install command again if you see module not found.

definition: The code tried to read an item past the end of a list.
exampleSentence: The loop caused an index out of range error on the last item.

definition: A variable or value that has not been set.
exampleSentence: The page showed undefined instead of the user's name.

definition: A value has a different data type than the code expects.
exampleSentence: Passing text instead of a number caused a type mismatch.

definition: A loop that never stops running.
exampleSentence: A missing condition created an infinite loop that froze the app.

definition: When a program keeps using more memory and never frees it.
exampleSentence: A memory leak made the server slower and slower every day.

definition: When two processes wait for each other forever and nothing continues.
exampleSentence: Two database transactions waited for each other and caused a deadlock.

definition: A bug that happens when the timing of two tasks changes the result.
exampleSentence: The bug only appears sometimes because of a race condition between two threads.

definition: Another program is already using the network port you chose.
exampleSentence: I saw port already in use, so I stopped the old server first.

definition: The network cannot reach the target computer.
exampleSentence: The ping command showed host unreachable when the VPN was off.

definition: The disk can be read but not changed.
exampleSentence: The update failed with read-only file system on the old SD card.

definition: The code contains a symbol where the computer did not expect it.
exampleSentence: A missing comma caused an unexpected token error in the JSON file.

definition: A message about a possible problem that does not stop the program.
exampleSentence: The compiler showed a warning about an unused variable.

definition: A serious error that stops the program completely.
exampleSentence: The installer stopped with a fatal error and closed itself.

definition: To try an action again after it failed.
exampleSentence: The app will retry the download three times before it gives up.
